Prophet Jeremiah, Lamentations 3:22 "The lovingkindness of the Lord..." to verse 56 "at my cry."
The Apostle, 1 Timothy 5:17 "Let the elders who rule well..." to verse 21 "by doing nothing out of partiality."
Alleluia, of the Martyrs, in the tone [of the day].
Gospel according to Matthew 10:26 "For there is nothing..." to verse 33 "who is in heaven."

Wednesday. Canticle of Repentance.
Midday Psalm 64 [65]: "Save your servants..."
The Apostle, Galatians 4:19 "My little children..." to 5:1 "you enter into bondage."
Alleluia, of the Fast, in the tone [of the day].
Gospel according to Luke 4:31 "And He went down to Capernaum..." to verse 40 "He healed them."

Thursday. Of the Holy Charitina and the witnesses Artemas, and Christopher, and the two women, Calinice and Aquilina. Tone [ah] and Canticle of the Martyrs. Magnificat [Mankunk], Tone 8 [dk], "Today with the..."
Midday Psalm 115 [116:15]: "Precious is..."
Proverbs (Wisdom of Solomon) 3:11 "My son, for whoever..." to verse 17 "their old age."
Prophet Isaiah 51:22 "Thus says the Lord God..." to 52:3 "you shall be redeemed without money."
The Apostle, 1 Thessalonians 2:13 "For this reason we also..." to verse 16 "to the uttermost."
Alleluia, of the Martyrs, in the tone [of the day].
Gospel according to John 15:11 "These things I have spoken..." to verse 16 "He may give you."

Friday. Canticle of Rest. Midday Psalm 97 [98]: "All have seen..."
The Apostle, Galatians 5:2 "Indeed I, Paul..." to verse 15 "you be consumed."
Alleluia, in the tone [of the day].
Gospel according to Luke 5:17 "And it happened on a certain day..." to verse 26 "new wonder."

Saturday. Of the Twelve Holy Doctors: Hierotheus of Athens, Dionysius the Areopagite, Sylvester of Rome, Athanasius of Alexandria, Cyril of Jerusalem, Ephrem the Syrian, Basil of Caesarea, Gregory of Nyssa, Gregory the Theologian, Epiphanius of Cyprus, John Chrysostom, and Cyril of Alexandria. Tone 2 [ak], "Who adorned..." with its proper [canons]. Magnificat [Mankunk], Tone 5 [gz], "Having distinguished themselves."
Midday Introit: "Of the Patriarchs."
Hymn, Tone 7 [dz], "Today the heavenly ones."
Psalm 131 [132]: "Let Your priests..."
Book of Proverbs 11:2 "The mouth of the humble..." to verse 11 "it is overthrown."
Prophet Isaiah 61:3 "And they shall be called..." to verse 1 "upon their heads."
The Apostle, Hebrews 13:7 "Remember those who rule over you..." to verse 9 "they have walked."
Alleluia, "Let Your priests..."
Gospel according to John 16:33 "These things I have spoken..." to 17:8 "You sent Me."
In the Evening: "Joyful Light."
Messedi: "You have given a banner to those who fear You" / "That they may be delivered."
"Holy God, who wast crucified."
Hymn of Ascent [Hambartsi], Tone 1 [az], "Wondrous and powerful."
Proclamation: "By Your Holy Cross" / "Save."
Prayer: "Guard us."

The Seventh Sunday: Discovery of the Cross [Khachgyut].
Tone 1 [adz], "Wondrous and powerful," with its proper [canons].
Morning Song: "You have given a banner to those who fear You."
Proclamation: "Let us say."
"Holy God, who wast crucified."
Psalm 4: "There has been signed..."
Proverbs (Wisdom of Solomon) 14:1 "Again, one preparing to sail..." to verse 8 "he made it."
Prophet Isaiah 33:22 "The Lord is our Father..." to 34:1 "who are in it."
The Apostle, 1 Corinthians 1:18 "For the message of the cross..." to verse 24 "the wisdom."
Alleluia: "Give strength."
Gospel according to Matthew 24:27 "For as the lightning..." to verse 36 "but the Father only."
Afterward: "Newly-created" [Norasteghtsyal].
Proclamation: "By Your Holy Cross" / "Save."
Prayer: "Guard us."
Midday Introit: "Before the honorable."
Antiphon: "The Lord reigns."
Hymn, Tone 3 [bz], "Today is sought."
The Psalm, Scripture reading, and Gospel are those of the morning.
Hagiography [Srbasatsutyun]: "Who is like unto..."
In the Evening, Messedi: "Of the Cross."
"Holy God, who wast crucified."
Hymn of Ascent [Hambartsi], Tone 3 [bz], "We have taken refuge."
Proclamation: "By Your Holy Cross" / "Save."
Prayer: "Guard us."

Monday. Of the Saints: Anastasius the Priest, and Varus, and Theodota and her sons, and those who were martyred with her. Canticle of the Martyrs. Midday Psalm 14 [15]: "Those who fear the Lord." Proverbs
